description.value: Moon Wok is a family-owned Chinese restaurant operating three locations across Kamloops, with the Valleyview location on Oriole Road. The menu spans over 100 items including appetizers, entrees, and combo dinners, with vegetarian and gluten-free options available. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, delivery, and full catering services, making it a versatile meal stop for cyclists of varying group sizes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record corresponds to the Valleyview location of Moon Wok, confirmed by the website listing '#4-111 Oriole Rd, Kamloops BC V2C 4N6' with phone 778-471-2882, matching OSM data exactly. The website confirms takeout/delivery and explicitly mentions vegetarian and gluten-free menu options; no bike-specific amenities (racks, pump, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The business appears active with recent OSM check date of 2025-12-27 and a functioning website.
concerns: OSM name 'Moon Wok' is shortened; the business markets itself as 'Moon Wok Chinese Restaurant' on its website — minor branding discrepancy.

This is a three-location chain; the OSM record covers the Valleyview location only. The North Shore (755 Tranquille Rd) and South Shore (1820 Rogers Place) locations may have or warrant separate OSM records, which could result in duplicate directory entries if not tracked.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active full-service restaurant in Kamloops with takeout and dine-in; a practical meal stop for touring cyclists. No bike-specific amenities confirmed, but the Food & Drink listing provides clear value.
